text:
maya: Heads up — planning to cut release/* for v1.16 in ~2h. Need confirmation on a few items before I trigger.
arjun: quick list? I have a couple of pending cherrypicks but can hold if needed.
maya: 1) version bump PR merged? 2) changelog tidy (no duplicate entries) 3) repo protection on release/* (who has perms to create?) 4) any backport exceptions to call out.
liam: version bump PR (https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4321) merged ✅ — tests passed but last e2e flake is being investigated.
sarah: changelog: I saw two entries from analytics and runtime that overlap. I can consolidate if we want a single line per change.
arjun: regarding perms, @ops-bot created the branch previously. I don't have direct create permissions for protected branches.
ops-bot: release branch creation requires role:release-manager or repo:maintainer. Use the release-bot workflow or request an on-callapprove.
release-bot: Automated checklist: version-bump ✓, changelog-smoke ✗ (conflict detected), protected-branch-ok ✗ (needs approval), tagging-plan ✗. See /release status 1719998000
maya: OK — @sarah can you collapse the two changelog entries into one short blurb? Then we clear the changelog-smoke.
sarah: on it. Proposed: "Improve KV cache handling (runtime) + analytics metrics migration fix" — short enough?
liam: that's fine. Also we should make a note in the PR body linking the cherry-picks that need to go to release/* post-cut.
arjun: I have two cherrypicks: #4327 (fix: kv-prefetch) and #4330 (docs: changelog anchor). Both are small.
maya: Good. Who's going to create the release/* branch? I can, but need `release-manager` approval in the org. @ops-bot can you trigger the bot flow?
ops-bot: Triggering approval flow. Please confirm the bump command you want used.
maya: use: ```scripts/release/create-branch.sh --version v1.16 --base main --tag v1.16-rc1```
release-bot: Approval requested from @liam and @arjun. Please respond with `approve` or `deny`.
liam: approve
arjun: approve
release-bot: approvals received (2). Creating branch release/v1.16 now...
release-bot: branch created: refs/heads/release/v1.16 and protected rules applied.
maya: branch created — I'm going to queue the cherry-picks once sarah finishes the changelog.
sarah: pushed changelog cleanup to https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4335 — short summary added.
maya: perfect. liam, can you put a note in the release notes doc with the KV cache entry and link PR 4327?
liam: done — added entry under "runtime" and linked PRs.
maya: final checklist: version bump merged (yes), changelog cleaned (yes), branch created and protected (yes), cherrypicks queued (maya/arjun) — I will open the cherrypick PRs now and ping for reviews.
arjun: I'll watch for the cherry-pick PR notifications. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
maya: cutting the release window now. If anything blocks, call it out here. Otherwise we go green in 10m for cut.
